name: ESP32 DevKit V1
microcontroller: ESP32 (dual-core Xtensa LX6, 240 MHz, WiFi and Bluetooth)

components.name: Push button
components.type: digital input, wired to GND, use the internal pull-up

notes: GPIO 34 to 39 are input only and have no internal pull-up or pull-down resistors.
ADC2 pins cannot read analog values while WiFi is active; analog inputs use ADC1 pins (GPIO 32 to 39).
Use the Adafruit SSD1306 and Adafruit GFX libraries for the display.
Use the Adafruit DHT sensor library for the DHT22.
The serial monitor runs at 115200 baud.
